question.text: Electrometallurgical process is used to extract

solution.text: Because <math> <mtext>Na</mtext> </math> is very reactive and can not be extracted by means of the reduction by <math><mtext>C</mtext></math>, <math><mtext>C</mtext><mtext>O</mtext><mo>.</mo></math> etc. So, it is extracted by electrolysis of molten <math> <mrow> <mtext>NaCl</mtext></mrow> </math> Solution.
